Hi Tessa,

We're getting Redwood set up in Oxbridge's supplier registry so AP can auto-match invoices against POs. To avoid back-and-forth with our onboarding team, can you confirm the following details and return the attached vendor enrollment form?

- Legal entity name (exact as you invoice)
- Remit address and invoice email (for AP ingestion)
- VAT ID (EU) or tax form (W-9 for US)
- Bank wiring details (IBAN/BIC or ACH) + remittance reference format you prefer
- Do you support e-invoicing (UBL/PEPPOL) or only PDF invoices? If e-invoice, please provide sample XML or mapping doc.
- PO matching rules we need to know: do you require line-level PO numbers, project codes, or can you accept header-level PO only?

Our supplier portal also asks for a sample invoice (PDF) and a signed vendor form — I've attached the Oxbridge_Vendor_Enrollment.docx for the portal. If you can fill and return by EOD Thursday (14 Oct), we can complete onboarding this week.

Thanks,
Daniel
Procurement Ops | Oxbridge Financial Services

Tessa —

Appreciate the quick reply and attachments. A couple of follow-ups from AP and tax:

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood issues VAT on UK-domiciled invoices, or should we apply reverse charge? If you don't have a UK VAT number we typically process invoices under reverse-charge; our tax team needs a short note you can include on the invoice ("reverse charge applies — recipient liable for VAT").

2) Please attach one clean sample invoice that includes: invoice number, invoice date, PO number, line-level descriptions, unit price, VAT amount (if any), and remittance details.

3) Portal requires we provide a primary vendor contact and a billing contact separately; please name and provide emails for both.

4) For mapping: we need to see what your UBL element name is for 'project code' (so our parser can map to GL_CODE). Could you send the tag name (e.g., <cbc:Note> or <cac:AdditionalDocumentReference>) you plan to use?

If you can send the sample invoice and the UBL snippet by EOD Monday we can finish the portal enrolment and return your Oxbridge vendor ID.

Jill and I can also arrange a short technical handoff between our AP integration engineer and your billing systems contact if helpful.

Best,
Daniel
